language.title: Display language
language.description: Choose the language MeowCode shows its interface in. Applies immediately, no restart needed.

speech.desc: Choose the tone style for AI replies. Changes take effect immediately.

progressPill.desc: When the composer status pill hides: after you commit, or when the turn ends.

island.desc: A capsule at the top center of your screen shows every running session; hover to expand it into a mini chat window where you can reply or stop a task.

close.desc: What happens when the main window closes: ask every time, hide to the system tray and keep running, or quit.

update.desc: New versions download quietly in the background; when ready, a restart button appears in the lower-left corner of the sidebar to install.

root.label: Worktree root directory
root.hint: Leave empty to use the default location. Restart the app for changes to take effect.

fetch.label: Always fetch upstream before creating a worktree
fetch.hint: Fetch upstream first when creating; skipped when offline or no remote is configured.

maxKeep.label: Worktrees to keep
maxKeep.hint: Older worktrees are deleted automatically. Worktrees used by pinned or running chats are kept.

agents.label: Include AGENTS.md in context
agents.hint: The agent reads AGENTS.md from the workspace root and adds it to the context.

claude.label: Include CLAUDE.md in context
claude.hint: The agent reads CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.local.md from the workspace root and adds them to the context.

rules.title: Rules
rules.hint: Create and manage rules that the agent follows during chat.
rules.emptyHint: Click Create to add your first rule
rules.noWorkspaceHint: Rules are stored in the project's .meowcode/rules directory.
rules.confirmDeleteAria: Click again to confirm deleting rule "{{name}}"
rules.editorDesc: Rules are injected into the system prompt with the project. Markdown is supported.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, e.g. code-style
rules.nameRule: Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; do not start or end with a hyphen.
rules.contentPlaceholder: e.g. Every new function needs JSDoc; do not edit generated/.

appearance.themeDesc: “System” follows the Windows light / dark setting in real time. Changes apply immediately, no restart needed.
appearance.paletteDesc: Pick the accent and canvas tint. Light and dark are tuned separately, so the colors adapt when you switch modes.
appearance.fontDesc: The interface font applies to chat, the sidebar and other UI text; the code font applies to code blocks, diffs and other monospaced text. Pick a system font or import a local font file (ttf / otf / woff / woff2). Changes apply immediately.
appearance.fontsLoading: Reading system fonts… click to retry

memory.toggleDesc: When on, each finished turn runs a light background pass that records what is worth remembering (preferences, corrections, project decisions); the memory index is injected into every conversation and the AI can read or write memory files on demand. When off, all three stop — existing memory files are kept on disk and can still be read as plain files.
memory.descUser: Long-term memory kept across workspaces: your preferences, recurring workflows, lessons learned. Stored in ~/.meowcode/memory/. The index is injected when a new chat starts, and the AI reads and writes entries with the memory tools.
memory.descProject: Memory specific to the current workspace, stored in the project's .meowcode/memory/ (not committed to git).
memory.descProjectNamed: Memory specific to the current workspace ({{workspace}}), stored in the project's .meowcode/memory/ (not committed to git).
memory.empty: No memories yet — when the AI learns something worth keeping in a chat it saves it here, and you can add entries yourself too.
memory.editorDesc: Edit the Markdown source. The frontmatter description goes into the MEMORY.md index (takes effect in new chats).
memory.name: Name
memory.nameRule: Names are lowercase kebab-case (letters, digits, hyphens), up to 64 characters

archive.desc: Archived chats stay out of the chat list and can be restored any time. To archive one, hover over a chat in the list and click the archive icon on the right. Deleting removes the chat record itself and cannot be undone.

about.author: Author
about.sponsorHint: If MeowCode has been useful to you, feel free to support the author by scanning a QR code.
about.upToDate: You're already on the latest version

projects.desc: Manage the workspaces you have added. Adding a project starts a new chat in that folder; removing one only hides it from the list and leaves chats and files untouched.
projects.removeMessage: Remove “{{name}}”? It will only be hidden from the list; chats and files stay untouched.

models.desc: Add model providers here, then enter the model name you want to use.
models.empty: No models configured yet. Click “Add Model” to get started.
models.managedHint: These models come from magpie. Restart MeowCode after magpie connects or disconnects to refresh. The enabled state and reasoning effort are kept.
models.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? You will need to set it up again before it can be used.
models.restartMessage: Model changes restart the local agent service, which interrupts the running turn. Save anyway?
models.deleteGroupMessage: Delete "{{name}}" and all {{count}} models under it? You will need to set it up again before it can be used.
models.levelsAuto: Leave empty to match by model name (currently {{levels}})
models.levelsManual: Set manually. Clear every level to go back to matching by model name.

authOptions.none: No auth header (local inference / set in headers)

picker.title: Add Model Provider
picker.desc: Pick a provider, then enter the model you want to use. The API format can be changed later. Not on the list? Use “Custom provider” and fill in the endpoint yourself.
picker.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or id, for example deepseek
picker.customMeta: Enter the endpoint and key by hand

form.desc: The provider is picked — now configure the model itself. API keys stay on this machine (encrypted with Windows credentials).
form.providerNameHint: Shown in the Provider column of the model list
form.apiFormatAuto: Detected from the request URL; picking one manually stops auto-detection
form.apiFormatDesc: Decides which endpoint the request hits and how the body is shaped; detected from the request URL
form.baseUrlHint: Enter the root URL and the API format is detected for you; the path is appended per format
form.modelIdHint: The model identifier from the provider's docs; required. One model ID can be configured more than once (different URL or key).
form.displayNamePlaceholder: Leave empty to show the model ID
form.displayNameHint: Affects the interface only, and must not duplicate an existing model
form.apiKeySaved: Already saved — leave empty to keep it
form.contextWindowHint: Detected from the model name if empty; 256K / 1M notation works
form.maxOutputHint: Detected from the model name if empty — how many tokens a single reply may produce
form.modalityHint: Image support is detected from the model name; PDF only rides the Anthropic / Responses protocols. Keep at least the text modality.
form.advancedHint: Reasoning effort / cache TTL / reasoning levels / auth and request tweaks — leave empty for defaults
form.cacheTtlHint: 1h writes cost 2×; automatic and 1h only take effect on endpoints verified to support the long TTL, everything else falls back to 5m
form.reasoningSummaryHint: Responses protocol only; summaries are billed as output tokens
form.nativeCompactionHint: Lets the provider compact history, which saves one full summarization request
form.authStyleHint: Keep the default for most providers; Azure / Bedrock need their own option
form.extraHeadersHint: One “name: value” per line; a line starting with # is a comment. For example OpenRouter's HTTP-Referer
form.extraBodyHint: A JSON object merged into the top level of the request body. For example Qwen's {"enable_thinking": false}
form.fetchHint: Only checked models are added to the list above.
form.modelSettingsDesc: Applies to this model only; endpoint, key and protocol are configured above.

error.duplicateName: The display name “{{name}}” is already configured
error.contextFormat: Invalid context window format — use something like 128k or 1M
error.maxOutputFormat: Invalid max output format — use something like 32k
error.extraBodyObject: The extra request body must be a JSON object
error.extraBodyJson: The extra request body isn't valid JSON: {{message}}

hooks.saving: Restarting the agent service to apply hooks…

import.description: Reads ~/.claude/settings.json and workspace .claude configs. Workspace configs are not executed by default.
import.masterHint: Load and run Claude Code hook configuration; when disabled it is shown read-only and never runs.
import.workspaceHint: Whether hooks in workspace .claude/settings*.json run; when off only the ~/.claude config runs.
import.workspaceWarning: Workspace hooks come from files in this repository and may contain malicious commands. Only enable them when you trust this repository.
import.disabledNote: Hooks are disabled. Turn on the switch above to run commands.

configured.description: Read-only summary. Open the config file to edit.
configured.empty: No Claude Code hooks are configured.

description.auto: Run hook commands automatically; PreToolUse `ask`/`deny` still apply.
description.ask: Ask before each hook command runs for the first time in a session; declining only skips that command.

options.autoDesc: No extra confirmation; follow the hook configuration
options.askDesc: Confirm each command once per session

confirm.title: Restart the agent service?
confirm.message: A turn is running. Saving hook settings will interrupt it.

dataImport.title: Data Import
dataImport.desc: Import new content from other apps; no automatic sync, and source app data is never modified.

learning.title: Self-learning
learning.desc: After a turn, the agent distils what it learned into reusable skills, project guidelines and a model of how you like to work. Nothing is trusted immediately: new items start on probation, must prove useful, and retire themselves if they get in the way.
learning.skillsDesc: Procedures the agent wrote for itself. Read a skill by its SKILL.md path; it is recalled by name and description.
learning.skillsEmpty: Nothing learned yet. Skills appear once a procedure succeeds and looks worth repeating.
learning.statsHint: helped / hurt — how often this item was recalled and whether the turn went well
learning.rollbackAria: Roll back {{name}} to the previous revision
learning.actionFailed: That action did not go through
learning.guidelinesDesc: Rules that only surface when their trigger matches — a command, an error, a keyword or a file pattern.
learning.profileDesc: Communication style, how much rigor you expect, how much autonomy you grant.
learning.profileEmpty: Nothing yet. These build up slowly from repeated evidence.
learning.clearHint: Deletes every learned skill, guideline, profile trait and the outcome history — in this project and across projects. Cannot be undone.

notify.desc: Show a system notification with the chat title and reply summary when a turn finishes, needs approval, or is interrupted while the window is in the background.

promptSuggestions.desc: After a reply finishes, predict what you might send next. Press Tab to put it in the input box.
promptSuggestions.confirmHow: After each reply, one extra request is sent to the current model to predict your next message. It appears in the empty input box; press Tab to fill it in. Nothing is sent until you send it yourself.
promptSuggestions.confirmCost: This uses additional tokens on every turn. The request reuses the conversation cache, so it is usually inexpensive, but it is still billed.

providerFallback.desc: When the primary provider times out, is rate-limited, or returns a server error, this turn automatically switches to another enabled provider (up to 2 hops).
providerFallback.toggleFailed: Failed to save the provider failover setting

mailAi.field: Model other than the chat model

announcement.desc: Show official announcements in the title bar (new releases and model news).

proxy.title: Network proxy
proxy.desc: Switch connection method when the network misbehaves. Applies immediately.
proxy.urlHint: For example http://127.0.0.1:7890 — leave empty to connect directly.
proxy.urlMissing: No address yet, so requests still go direct.
proxy.failed: Could not apply the proxy setting

enabled.label: File snapshots
enabled.hint: A checkpoint is taken at the start of every turn; files written or edited can be rewound together with the conversation. Restart the app after changing.

keep.label: Snapshots to keep
keep.hint: Keep file snapshots for the most recent N checkpoints per session; older ones are cleaned up.

maxTotal.label: Snapshot size cap
maxTotal.hint: Total size cap of one session's snapshot directory; oldest snapshots are reclaimed first.

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.modeFullDesc: The Agent can read and write files outside the workspace.
sandbox.modeWorkspaceDesc: Commands can only write to the workspace and extra writable roots.
sandbox.deleteDesc: Only applies in workspace-write mode; full access skips deletion confirmation by default.
sandbox.unsupported: The command sandbox is only available on Windows.
sandbox.riskDoes: Enabling writes a standing ACL and Low integrity label to the workspace and runs run_command under a restricted token.
sandbox.riskDoesNot: It does not restrict reads or network, nor file-editing tools. A blocked command asks separately whether to retry once outside the sandbox.
sandbox.riskUndo: Switch back to full access to stop sandboxing; the workspace ACL remains but is no longer used.

dataLocation.desc: Where settings, conversations, and local fonts are stored.
dataLocation.confirmDesc: Your current data will be copied to the new location and the app will restart. The original data will be kept.

errors.same_path: The new location is the same as the current one.
errors.not_empty: The target folder isn't empty. Choose an empty folder.

approvals.desc: Actions you approved with "Don't ask again" in this project. Revoking a rule makes the next attempt ask again; file rules expire automatically once the file changes.
approvals.clearConfirmDesc: These actions will ask for approval again. File rules already expire automatically when the file changes.

storage.deviceDesc: Manage chats and worktrees stored on this computer.

clean.title: Clean old chats
clean.hint: Review chats and their subagents before deleting them permanently.
clean.dialogDesc: Deleting permanently removes the session files and their subagents; oldest first.

worktrees.title: Manage worktrees
worktrees.hint: Review working copies and choose how many old worktrees to keep.

archived.title: Archived chats
archived.hint: Restore or delete individual archived chats.

connections.desc: Manage SSH settings for remote servers. Passwords are never saved; enter them in the terminal when connecting.
connections.testPassword: Password auth can't be tested automatically. Connect and enter the password in the terminal.

form.name: Name
form.note: Passwords are not saved; enter them in the terminal after connecting.
form.invalid: Fill in host and username, and make sure the port is valid

webSearch.desc: Choose separate providers for search and fetch. "Auto" follows the current model's capabilities and never silently switches providers.

search.label: Search provider
search.hint: When off, the model doesn't see the web_search tool; web fetching is unaffected.

fetch.label: Fetch provider
fetch.hint: DeepSeek Fetch API uses the key below; without a key, the current model must be DeepSeek.

originalQuestion.label: Send original question
originalQuestion.hint: Send the latest user question (up to 128 characters) with DeepSeek searches for better results.

deepseekKey.label: DeepSeek API key
deepseekKey.hint: Used to call the official Search / Fetch API when the current model isn't DeepSeek. Stored encrypted on this device.
deepseekKey.saved: Saved; leave empty to keep it

agents.desc: Subagents, parallel limits and prompts per main agent. New subagents are written into that architecture and connected to the main agent by default.
agents.name: Name
agents.promptHint: Leave empty to use the role's built-in prompt.
agents.added: Added and connected to the main agent
